alerts.title: Next water turn Tuesday 17 Nov
alerts.why: Wheat is tillering. Soil at 86%, above the 50% refill point. No rain in the forecast.
steps: Water on your turn Tuesday, early morning.
Make sure water reaches the north edge.
alerts.voice: الأرض فيها مية كفاية لحد دورك يوم التلات.

alerts.title: Little rust weather this week
alerts.why: 0 of the last 7 nights were foggy and humid. Nights 13 to 14 °C. Your variety resists rust well.
steps: From January, walk the field once a week.
alerts.source: Rust weather index, NASA POWER and Open-Meteo humidity and dew point

alerts.title: New satellite image: the north edge looks weaker
alerts.why: The north edge is 28% less green than the rest, two images in a row.
alerts.voice: فيه حتة في الأرض أضعف من الباقي. روح بص عليها.

alerts.title: Weeding starts around 18 Nov
alerts.why: Weeks 3 to 6 after sowing are the critical weed-free period for wheat sown 28 Oct.
steps: Hoe or hand weed before fertilizing.
alerts.voice: نضّف الأرض من الحشايش لحد يوم 9.

alerts.title: No heat risk this week
alerts.why: Highs of 27 to 28 °C. Wheat is not yet at a heat sensitive stage.
